text: 1.High school graduate or equivalent or above. 2.Applicants must be in good health 3.Over age of 18. Applicant whose age is under 18 needs to submit notarial certificate of guardianship Note: For those who apply for Spring Semester, a copy of HSK Level 3 is required; or they should pass the Chinese Entrance Exam (equal to HSK Level 3) organized by UIBE; Those who can not pass will be transferred to study in Elementary Chinese Program. For those who apply for Fall Semester, HSK is not required. Students need to attend a placement test at the beginning of the Semester.
